description: 新北市公共自行車租借站及價格(新版) [bus and public transit and cycling and walking networks] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 新北市政府水利局. 資料由新北市政府高灘地工程管理處所提供主要欄位包含了出租日類型、租借站名稱、電話、位置、營運時間、現場借用一小時淑女/幼童車(平日/假日)、現場借用二小時淑女/幼童車(平日/假日)、現場借用六小時淑女/幼童車(平日/假日)、現場借用一小時變速車、現場借用二小時變速車、現場借用六小時變速車、現場借用一小時高級變速車/協力車、現場借用二小時高... Coverage: 新北市政府水利局. The portal files it under the publisher 新北市政府水利局. Its tags are 休閒旅遊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-08-13 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
